M. Sue Werner OBITUARY
M. Sue Werner OBITUARY
Mary Susan “Sue” Werner, 81, of Reading, passed away October 5, 2026, at Phoebe Berks, Wernersville. Born October 14, 1944, in Reading, she was the daughter of the late James and Mary (Stettler) Ulrich. She taught physical education at Governor Mifflin High School, Wyomissing High School, and the former Central Catholic High School, now Berks Catholic. She was the first female athletic director in Berks County and dedicated more than 30 years to teaching and coaching. Sue was an active and devoted member of Calvary United Methodist Church in Mohnton. She will be lovingly remembered by her children, Jamie (Werner) Reeger and John Werner, along with their spouses Larry Reeger and Corinne (Foreman) Werner; her six grandchildren, Madison (Werner) McCluskey and spouse Tyler McCluskey, Jordan Werner, Meagan Werner, Johnny Werner, Leah Reeger, and Caden Reeger; and two great-grandchildren Raylyn McCluskey and Wyatt Werner. She is also survived by her siblings, James and his wife, Marsha Ulrich; Rebecca and her husband, Ivan Mengel; and Jo and her husband, John Ressler. Memorial services will be held Monday, October 12, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. at Calvary United Methodist Church, Mohnton, with the Rev. Jong Kim officiating. The family will receive friends one hour prior to the service; there will also be a time for sharing stories immediately following the service. A luncheon will be held at the church immediately following the service. In lieu of flowers, memorial contributions may be made to the Alzheimer’s Assn. at www.alz.org or to her church at the above address. For expanded obituary visit www.mullfh.com
